name: West Pharmaceutical Services
outlook:
What West Pharmaceutical Services says to expect

  • Full year 2026: net sales• The Company is increasing its full-year 2026 net sales guidance range to $3.41 billion to $3.42 billion, up from the previous range of $3.345 billion to $3.380 billion.
  • Full year 2026: adjusted diluted earnings per share• The Company is increasing its full-year 2026 adjusted-diluted EPS guidance range to $9.38 to $9.48, up from the previous range of $8.85 to $9.05.
  • Full year 2026: capital spending• Full-year 2026 capital spending guidance is updated to a range of $215 million to $220 million, down from the prior range of $250 million to $275 million.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 29, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
